conversation.message: How have you been feeling lately, overall?
Honestly? I’ve been really down. I used to love coming home to my apartment, but now it just feels empty. I don't know how to make it feel... right again.
What do you think would help your apartment feel less empty?
I don't know. I've tried cleaning, decorating... nothing sticks. I just end up sitting on the couch and staring at the walls. It’s like I’m just going through the motions.
Is it harder to focus or concentrate than it used to be?
Yeah. I read a page in a book and I forget what I read. It's like my mind is just... wandering. I get frustrated because I can't even finish a sentence.
How long has it been since you could read a page without your mind wandering like that?
I don't know... a year? Maybe two? It used to be my favorite thing to do, but now I just can't.
How have you been sleeping lately?
Bad. I wake up in the middle of the night and just lie there. I can't turn my brain off. It's like I’m stuck in this... this limbo.
How long do you usually lie awake once you wake up?
Hours. Sometimes I get up and walk around, but mostly I just stare at the ceiling. I don't know how to make it stop.
Been doing anything you enjoy lately?
Nothing. I used to love hiking, but now it feels like too much work. I just... I don't have the energy for it anymore.
How long has it felt like too much work to do the things you used to love?
A few months? Maybe longer? It's hard to keep track. Everything just feels... heavy.
When you think about the next few weeks, what do you expect day to day?
Just more of the same. Waking up, staring at the wall... going through the motions. I don't see a light at the end of the tunnel.
When you say you don't see a light at the tunnel, what does that feel like for you?
It feels like I'm just... stuck. Like I’m walking in circles and getting nowhere.
Do you find it harder to make decisions than before, even small ones?
Yeah. Even what to eat for dinner is hard. I just stand there in the kitchen and can't decide. It's like my brain is broken.
How long do you usually find yourself standing there, trying to decide?
Twenty minutes? Half an hour? It doesn't matter. It's just... frustrating.
Do you feel like you have enough energy for your usual day?
No. I’m exhausted all the time. Just... physically and mentally.
How long has this exhaustion been affecting your daily routine?
Months? Years? I don't know. It just... it feels like I'm running on empty all the time.
Are you still into the things you used to care about?
No. I used to love music, but I haven't listened to a new song in months. I don't care. Nothing excites me.
When you think about listening to music now, what comes to mind?
Nothing. Just... nothing. It doesn't interest me. I used to love it, but now it just sounds... loud.
Is there anything weighing on your mind that you wish you could change?
Everything. I wish I could just... start over. But I can't.
What feels the most difficult to start over from?
My life. Just... everything. I feel like I’m stuck in a rut and I don't know how to get out.
How do you feel about how things have gone for you recently?
I don't know... I just... I don't feel good about it. I feel like I let everything go wrong.
What feels like it went wrong?
Everything. My job, my relationship... my life. I just... I feel like I failed.
How's your appetite been?
Bad. I just... I don't have an appetite. I force myself to eat because I need to, but I don't enjoy it.
How long has it been since food stopped being enjoyable?
I don't know... a year? Maybe longer? It’s just... food doesn't taste good anymore.
Have you found yourself getting emotional more easily lately?
Yes. I get emotional about nothing. I just... I feel like I’m on edge all the time.
